name: Peepz My Dream Restaurant
blurb: Run the lunch service. Take an order, cook it, carry it out before the customer gives up - and spend the takings on a bigger kitchen. Out of the front door is the garden, and past the garden is the house you are earning it for: one purse, one plot of land, two cartridges. Not a level - this document names a game the host runs, and the host is the space it is opened in.
